pages.text: Upon consumption, grants the eater:$(br)$(li)Permanent Quietus II$(li)Permanent Fasting$(li)Deals 2 points of hunger damage to the eater every 0.5 seconds$(li)Disables the eater's health regeneration$(li)The latter 2 effects last 5 minutes
